name: Composite SDF via Union and Subtraction
aliases: Bubble SDF via Union and Subtraction
definition: The SDF for bubbles is defined as the union of N ellipsoids. Since ellipsoid SDFs lack a simple closed form, a lower bound of the signed distance field is used.
